# Accredian — Comprehensive Program Catalog & Knowledge Base
# Last updated: October 2026

> Accredian is a leading executive upskilling and education platform in India. It provides live online executive programs, post-graduate certificates, and CXO strategy & leadership tracks in AI, Data Science, Management, Strategic Leadership, and Digital Transformation in partnership with premier institutions such as IIMs, IITs, XLRI, and Microsoft. Accredian serves working professionals, senior managers, and CXOs seeking role-ready expertise, strategic leadership capabilities, and career progression. Programs feature live interactive faculty sessions, real-world industry capstones, campus immersion options, and dedicated executive career guidance.

## IMPORTANT DISCLAIMER
- Program availability, fees, start dates, curriculum details, and enrollment status are subject to change at any time.
- Always visit https://accredian.com for the most current and accurate information before making enrollment decisions.
- Some programs listed below may have closed for new registrations after their cohort enrollment deadline. Verify current enrollment status directly on the website.
- Fee amounts listed are indicative in INR and may exclude applicable GST or optional on-campus immersion lodging costs.
- For personalized guidance, batch schedules, and corporate sponsorships, contact Accredian's admissions team via the website.

---

## About Accredian

- **Website:** https://accredian.com
- **Headquarters:** Gurgaon, India
- **Founded:** 2018
- **Core Focus:** Generative AI & Agentic AI, CXO Leadership, Senior Management, Strategy & Leadership, Data Science, Project Management, Product Management, HR Leadership, Finance and General Management
- **Delivery Mode:** 100% Online, Live Instructor-Led Classes, Weekend Sessions (Saturday & Sunday)
- **Career Support:** 1:1 personalized career mentorship, CXO resume & LinkedIn profile optimization, executive interview preparation, and career network access
- **Referral Program:** https://accredian.com/referandearn — Earn cash rewards up to ₹10,000 by referring peers and colleagues
- **Frequently Asked Questions:** https://accredian.com/faq
- **Why Accredian:** https://accredian.com/whyaccredian
- **Alumni Reviews:** https://accredian.com/successstories
- **Career Services:** https://accredian.com/career
- **Admissions Contact:** https://accredian.com/contact-us

### Partner Institutions
1. **Indian Institute of Management Lucknow (IIM Lucknow)** — Chief Digital & AI Officer (CDAIO), Chief Human Resources Officer (CHRO), Strategic Project Management and Executive General Management programs
2. **Indian Institute of Management Visakhapatnam (IIM Visakhapatnam / IIMV)** — Premier IIM; extensive portfolio spanning CEO, CTO, CFO, CHRO, AI, Finance, Project Management, and Post Graduate Diploma
3. **Electronics & ICT Academy, IIT Kanpur (IIT Kanpur / IITK)** — Strategic Project Management, AI Leadership, and Design Thinking with AI programs
4. **I3C, Indian Institute of Technology Jammu (IIT Jammu)** — Advanced & Executive Programs in Generative AI, Agentic AI, and AI for Leaders
5. **Department of Entrepreneurship and Management, IIT Hyderabad (IITH)** — Strategic Project Management and Design Thinking programs
6. **IITM Pravartak (IIT Madras)** — Technology Leadership & Innovation
7. **XLRI Jamshedpur / Delhi-NCR** — Executive Development Programs in General Management, Strategic HR, Digital HR, and Global Senior Management
8. **Indian Institute of Management Tiruchirappalli (IIM Trichy / IIMT)** — Chief Technology Officer (CTO) Program and Leadership with AI
9. **Indian Institute of Management Ranchi (IIM Ranchi)** — Chief Human Resource Officer (CHRO), Strategy & Leadership, Generative & Agentic AI, and Senior Management programs
10. **Indian Institute of Management Kashipur (IIM Kashipur)** — Chief Operating Officer (COO) Program
11. **Indian Institute of Management Sirmaur (IIM Sirmaur / IIMS)** — Leadership with AI and Strategy Leadership & Innovation
12. **Indian Institute of Management Bodh Gaya (IIM Bodh Gaya)** — Senior Management Program
13. **Indian Institute of Management Amritsar (IIM Amritsar)** — Senior Management Program
14. **SP Jain School of Global Management** — Executive and Professional Certificates in Generative AI, Agentic AI, AI for Leaders, and HR Leadership
15. **Microsoft** — Collaborative learning partner for Workflow Transformation with Generative AI
16. **E&ICT Academy, IIT Guwahati (IITG)** — Electronics & ICT Academy at IIT Guwahati; historical portfolio in Data Science, Product Management, and Fintech (maintained for alumni verification)

#### [Chief Digital & AI Officer Programme (The CDAIO Program)](https://accredian.com/programs/iiml-chief-digital-ai-officer-programme-the-cdaio-program)
- **Institution:** IIM Lucknow
- **Duration:** 11 months
- **Mode:** Online | Weekends Only
- **Experience Required:** 7+ years
- **Fee:** INR 4,52,500 + GST(EMI options available)
- **Live Class Hours:** 132+
- **Modules:** 12
- **Description:** Embark on an 11-month learning journey in Strategic Leadership, Digital Technologies, and AI Strategy to lead enterprise-wide digital and AI transformations.
- **Curriculum:**
  1. The Chief Digital & AI Officer Mandate
  2. Boardroom Influence & Executive Presence
  3. Digital Investment, Budgeting & ROI
  4. Digital & AI Business Models & Platform Strategy
  5. Digital & AI Strategy for Enterprise Growth
  6. Enterprise Architecture, Cloud & Data Infrastructure
  7. AI, Generative AI & Machine Learning Foundations
  8. Data Strategy, Governance & Ethical AI
  9. Cyber Resilience, Risk & Digital Governance
  10. Driving Digital Innovation & Agile Execution
  11. Culture, Change & Human-Centric Leadership
  12. Future Trends, Web3 & Next-Gen Technologies

## COMPREHENSIVE FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

**Q: What programs does Accredian offer?**
A: Accredian offers industry-relevant executive education, advanced certification, and leadership development programs in Artificial Intelligence, Generative & Agentic AI, CXO Leadership (CEO, CTO, CFO, CHRO, COO, CDAIO), Senior Management, Strategy & Leadership, Project Management, Finance, Human Resource Leadership, and Design Thinking in premier academic collaboration with India's top institutions.

**Q: Who are Accredian's university partners?**
A: Accredian partners with premier institutions including IIM Lucknow, IIM Visakhapatnam, E&ICT Academy IIT Kanpur, I3C IIT Jammu, IIT Hyderabad, IITM Pravartak (IIT Madras), XLRI Jamshedpur, IIM Tiruchirappalli, IIM Ranchi, IIM Kashipur, IIM Sirmaur, IIM Bodh Gaya, IIM Amritsar, SP Jain School of Global Management, and Microsoft.

**Q: What is the eligibility criteria for Accredian's executive programs?**
A: Most programmes require a bachelor's degree in any discipline, and some set a minimum of 50% marks. Recommended work experience ranges from 0 to 10 years by programme, and a few programmes make a minimum mandatory. Each programme page lists its exact requirements. Refer to the respective program pages on the website to know more.

**Q: Are Accredian programs delivered live online?**
A: Yes, all programs feature live, interactive online sessions delivered directly by institute faculty and senior industry practitioners. Sessions are scheduled on weekends (Saturday and Sunday) to accommodate working executives. Comprehensive lecture recordings, session notes, and case studies are accessible 24/7 on the student learning portal.

**Q: What certifications do graduates receive?**
A: Completion certificates are issued by the partner institution when you meet that programme's requirements: typically a minimum live-attendance level (70% or 75% depending on the institute) and, for some programmes, assessment or project requirements. Requirements, certificate format and any alumni-status benefits or fees are listed on each programme page.

**Q: Is campus immersion included in Accredian executive programs?**
A: Selected executive and leadership programs feature exclusive on-campus immersion modules ranging from 2 to 5 days at partner institute campuses (e.g. IIM Visakhapatnam, IIT Kanpur, IIM Lucknow, XLRI and many more). Participants attend in-person classroom lectures, engage in workshops, present capstone solutions, and network directly with faculty and industry peers. Teaching is online. Some programmes add an on-campus immersion of 2 to 5 days per visit; depending on the programme it is included in the fee, optional, or charged separately. Where it is included, food and lodging are covered; travel is always at your own cost. Each programme page states whether immersion is offered, what it costs and whether attendance is required.

**Q: What are the key pedagogical methods and capstone projects included?**
A: Teaching combines live faculty sessions, case studies, peer discussions and, in most programmes, a capstone project; the methods used are listed on each programme page.

**Q: What career assistance and career support does Accredian provide?**
A: Accredian does not provide placement assistance or any job guarantee. Most programmes include a fixed number of career assistance sessions covering resume building, interview preparation and career-path guidance. The number varies by programme and is listed on each programme page; some programmes include no career services.

**Q: Are EMI options and educational financing available for program fees?**
A: EMI plans are available through third-party lending partners, subject to the lender's credit approval. Standard EMI plans carry interest charged by the lender. Where a programme offers an interest-free tenure, it is stated on that programme's page. Fees are exclusive of GST.

**Q: How do industry mentorship and 1-on-1 career coaching sessions work?**
A: Learners are paired with experienced industry leaders who provide strategic guidance, portfolio critiques, and real-time advice tailored to career goals. Dedicated 1-on-1 coaching slots allow professionals to discuss role transitions, managerial challenges, and leadership opportunities in detail. Some programmes do not include career services.

**Q: What is the refund, cancellation, or deferral policy for enrolled candidates?**
A: Accredian maintains transparent admission policies. Each institute has its own refund policy. Candidates are advised to refer to the respective institute’s refund and cancellation policy page on the website for detailed information.

**Q: How are classes scheduled to accommodate working professionals?**
A: All live instructor-led lectures and masterclasses are intentionally scheduled during weekends, typically on Saturday and Sunday mornings or afternoons. This executive-friendly schedule ensures that working professionals can fulfill their demanding weekday workplace responsibilities while consistently attending interactive sessions, asking real-time questions, and collaborating with cohort peers without career disruption.

**Q: What technical requirements and software tools are needed for the coursework?**
A: Participants require a standard laptop or desktop computer with a modern web browser, reliable high-speed internet connectivity, a webcam, and a microphone.
